caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden hand plane centered against a plain, light beige background. The hand plane is predominantly brown with various shades indicating the grain and wear of the wood. It has a rectangular body with rounded edges on the right and angular edges on the left, with diamond-shaped wooden embellishments containing circular elements on the side facing the viewer. The blade of the plane is visible, set at an angle, and has a metallic sheen with a reddish-brown hue. Protruding from the blade is a wooden handle with a curved knob. In the bottom left quadrant of the drawing, there is a small, irregularly shaped piece of what appears to be parchment or a label with faint, handwritten text. The artist's name, "Max Lingner," is written in small, neat letters toward the lower right of the image.
title: Bead Plane
